about: Shared policy cases for the module HTML cache (C API 1.13 to 1.15 policy surface).
Canonical copy: test/lib/cache/daemon_html_policy_cases.json in pagespeed-optimizer.
No other repository keeps a copy; module test lanes exercise this policy through a
library built from a pinned optimizer commit.
HASH PIN. FNV-1a 64 over this file's bytes with every carriage return removed
(offset basis 0xcbf29ce484222325, prime 0x100000001b3). The pinned value is
kDaemonHtmlPolicyCasesFnv1a64 in test/lib/cache/daemon_html_policy_cases.h.
Any edit to this file must update that constant in the same change, or
daemon_html_policy_cases_test fails.
ROWS. Each row has: id (unique, [a-z0-9-]), runners (exactly ["policy"]), why
(a public label: an RFC section or a short rule name), and policy {call, input,
expect}. Every row must run with zero skips. An expect key that is absent is not
asserted; every key that is present is.
call store: ps_html_store_classify. input: mode (off | report-only |
serve-variants | serve-cached-html, or an integer for a malformed value), method,
url_path, request (subset of authorization, authenticated_user, cookie,
no_store), status, headers ([name, value] per line, in order), body (the body
and its prefix), body_bytes (overrides the body length when present),
body_complete, max_body_bytes, now_s. expect: action (refuse | store |
store_no_notify | would_store | would_store_no_notify | malformed = return -1),
reason (ps_html_store_reason_name), detail, lifetime_s, flags (each named
PS_HTML_STORE_FLAG_* bit is set; lifetime_explicit, needs_validation,
has_validators, explicit_shared), cc_flags (each named PS_CC_ORIGIN_* bit is set).
call serve: ps_html_serve_classify. input: mode (as for store); request {method, accept (list
of Accept lines, joined in order with ", "; key absent = no header; [""] =
an empty header), authorization, authenticated_user, cookie, cache_control,
pragma (header values; absent = no header), range, if_range, origin (header
present), if_none_match (header value), now_s}; stored {the stored-facts
struct: present, stored_at, age_at_store, lifetime_s, needs_validation,
explicit_shared, headers_not_reproducible, sidecar_required, sidecar_present,
purged, cc_flags (names of PS_CC_ORIGIN_* bits), variant_present, binding_live,
withheld, render_ttl_s, binding_hash, markdown_hash (64 hex = 32 bytes)}.
expect: action (fall_through | serve_markdown | serve_html | validate |
malformed = an error return for a malformed call, such as a mode outside the
set), reason
(ps_html_serve_reason_name), enforce, wants_markdown, age_s, and outcome.
outcome is composed from library calls only: serve_markdown with an
if_none_match that ps_if_none_match_matches_weak matches against
ps_html_markdown_etag(binding_hash, markdown_hash) is markdown_304; any other
serve_markdown is markdown_200; every other action is fall_through.
call facts: write input.volume into a real temporary cache volume (original =
the HTML entry with stored_at, lifetime_s, cc_flags, origin_html_hash (null =
no stamp) and optional sidecar_required (the entry needs a header block);
markdown = the Markdown copy with its origin_html_hash and
markdown_hash; withheld_marker = {parent_hash, deriver_version current |
previous (the library's deriver version minus one), reason}; sidecar = a
header block written beside the entry), read them back, and call
ps_html_stored_facts_from_reads. expect: any field of the produced facts
(present, variant_present, binding_live, withheld, explicit_shared,
sidecar_present, sidecar_required, needs_validation, stored_at, age_at_store,
lifetime_s, cc_flags = exactly these PS_CC_ORIGIN_* names), etag (the
ps_html_markdown_etag of the produced binding_hash and markdown_hash, which
the facts fill from the copy's stamped content hash only for a live binding;
null = no tag can be made), and serve {action,
reason}: ps_html_serve_classify on the produced facts in serve-variants with
GET, Accept text/markdown and input.now_s.
call etag: ps_html_markdown_etag(binding_hash, markdown_hash) over the raw
32-byte values. expect: etag, exactly W/"psm-<16 lowercase hex>", the first 8
bytes of SHA-256(binding_hash || markdown_hash).
call inm: ps_if_none_match_matches_weak(if_none_match, etag). expect: match.
"*" alone matches; "*" inside a list is invalid and matches nothing.
call write_params: ps_html_store_write_params. input: capture_start_ms (the
library floors it to seconds), age (the inbound Age header lines, in order;
absent = no Age). expect: valid (false = an error return: the caller stores
nothing), inserted_at_s (floored capture start minus Age), age_at_store (the
age the entry records beside inserted_at_s; Age is counted once, so 0 when
inserted_at_s already carries it). Equal repeated lines count as one; a
conflicting, malformed, negative, fractional or larger-than-capture Age is
invalid.
call notify: ps_notify_worker_ex argument check. input: content (html | css |
js | image | other), flags (from_module, host_vouched, html_stored, or
reserved_0x<hex> for a reserved bit), site (64 lowercase hex, PS_SITE_ID_CHARS, or null),
agent_request, mask (llms_txt when present). expect: valid (false =
PS_ERR_INVALID_ARG with no connection attempted; true = the argument check
passed, whatever the delivery result). Every other argument is valid (url
https://www.example.test/page, hostname www.example.test, scheme https, no
options context), so a valid:false row fails only for the input it names.
PENDING ROWS. A row could carry pending (the one value c-api-1.15) while it
stated a verdict of a library surface not built yet; the runner skipped it and
counted it apart. The 1.15 surface is built and no row is pending: the schema
check refuses the marker, and every key, call and value below marked (1.15)
is open to every row.
(1.15) serve input adds: struct_size (1.14 = the earlier request size, whose
1.15 fields read as zero; absent = this library's size), serve_scope (agents |
all, or an integer for a value outside the set), agent_class (an integer; 0 =
unknown, 1 to 3 the known-agent classes), html_max_lifetime_s (0 or absent =
no cap), request_flags (names of the new request bits: fresh_only,
html_fallback, conditional, explicit_public), policy_stamp (16 lowercase hex;
absent = 0), request_guard (see guard: the runner calls ps_html_request_guard
first, as a caller must, and a reason it returns is the row's verdict, a
fall_through for serve and a refuse for store; otherwise the classifier runs).
Absent 1.15 keys are zero. A row's request_guard repeats its guard row through
the runner's composition and adds no classifier coverage. stored adds
store_v2 and anonymous_recorded, validated_this_request and
entry_policy_stamp (16 hex). DEFAULTS: absent store_v2 and anonymous_recorded
read as true, so the 1.14 rows keep their verdicts; every 1.15 row states both,
and the entry stamp, explicitly. serve expect adds not_modified. New serve reasons: scope,
capped, conditional, credentialed, legacy_entry, policy_mismatch,
request_header, path.
(1.15) store input adds credentialed (anonymous-only | explicit-public; the
runner sets the explicit-public request bit for explicit-public), which every
1.15 store row states, and request_guard as for serve;
expect flags adds request_anonymous, and flags_clear names bits that must be
clear. New store reasons: request_header, path.
(1.15) call store_write: the store input plus policy_stamp,
capture_start_ms and sidecar_format3 (absent = true; false = a caller that
does not opt in to the format-3 header block, as an earlier module does); the
runner classifies, and when the verdict stores, calls
ps_html_store_write_params with the classifier's flags as a module HTML store.
expect: action, reason, written
(whether write parameters were produced), entry_flags and entry_flags_clear
(store_v2 = 0x80, anonymous_recorded = 0x40 on the stored entry), policy_stamp
(the stamp the header block carries).
(1.15) facts input adds volume.original.written_by (front = as an optimizer
front writes an original; module_v1 = bytes a 1.14 library wrote before the
upgrade; module_v2_no_stamp = an earlier module calling the 1.15 library
without the format-3 opt-in; module_v2_anonymous and module_v2_credentialed =
the 1.15 module store for an anonymous and a cookie request; DEFAULT when
absent: module_v2_anonymous with no stamp, which is what the 1.14 facts rows
describe), volume.sidecar_policy_stamp (a format-3 header block with that
stamp), and serve_request {mode, accept, serve_scope, agent_class,
request_flags, policy_stamp, struct_size} to replace the serve check's
request. expect adds store_v2, anonymous_recorded and entry_policy_stamp.
(1.15) call guard: ps_html_request_guard(raw_path, header names and values,
keyed_scheme). input: raw_path, headers ([name, value] per line), keyed_scheme.
expect: reason (none | request_header | path), header_index (the index of the
refused header line) and xfp (the refusal is an X-Forwarded-Proto scheme
mismatch), so a caller needs no header list of its own.
(1.15) call cookies: ps_html_classify_cookies. input: cookie_lines (the Cookie
lines in order; [] = no header), ignore_builtin, additions. expect: class
(none | ignorable_only | blocking), first_blocking (the first blocking name;
"" when there is none to name), ignorable_values (the listed cookies' values,
in order, unquoted, for the echo check). A name that matches a built-in
session pattern is never ignorable, whatever the additions; a pair without
= or with an empty name makes the request blocking.
(1.15) call ignore_guard: ps_html_ignore_cookie_guard. input: addition. expect:
accepted, warning. An addition is refused when it is empty, *, has a * other
than one trailing *, fewer than 3 characters before it, a character outside
a cookie-name token, matches a built-in session pattern in any case, or, as a
prefix, would cover a session pattern's fixed leading part. An accepted
prefix warns (it may still match a session-shaped name, which classification
then blocks).
(1.15) call stamp: ps_html_policy_stamp for two settings a and b, each
{credentialed anonymous-only | explicit-public, ignore_builtin, list_version
current | next (the built-in list's version plus one), additions}. expect:
equal (the two stamps), nonzero (both).
(1.15) call invalidate: ps_html_unsafe_method_invalidates(method, status).
input: method (a string, or null for NULL), status. expect: invalidates.
(1.15) call format: ps_html_decision_format. input: fields ([key, value] in the
order passed). expect: line (the exact line, or null for a refused call). The
1.15 keys scope, agent_class and detail (a cookie or header NAME, never a
value) follow the existing keys. Reasons are one vocabulary with the engine:
cookie_request and cookie_echo carry the cookie name in detail.
